verdict.rationale: Tax-agency service portals can plausibly offer programmatic access with scoped credentials, so this story applies to the product. The evidence pack only records Akamai 403 denials at www.ftb.ca.gov and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Nothing in it documents an API or a way to issue scoped or least-privilege credentials to an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
